roleContext.jobDescription: An industrial compressor manufacturer sells condition monitoring to customers with service contracts. The machine learning engineer develops failure-prediction models from controller telemetry, is the accountable owner of models listed in the company's model register, keeps the telemetry pipelines running and reviews alerts with field-service engineers. The company is starting to run models on the compressor controllers themselves and would value experience of deploying models onto equipment in the field. The data science team of four reports to the head of digital services, and each production model in the register has one named owner who answers for it at the quarterly model review.

requirements.text: Develops failure-prediction models from equipment telemetry.
Is the registered owner of a production model, approving retraining releases and threshold changes.
Builds telemetry ingestion and feature pipelines.
Reviews model alerts with field-service engineers against inspection findings.
Has deployed models to run on equipment controllers in the field.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Machine Learning Engineer, Predictive Maintenance

## Experience

- Machine learning engineer at Halvorsen Compressors from August 2019 to May 2024, building failure-prediction models for industrial air compressors from vibration and temperature telemetry.
- Recorded as model owner for the bearing-failure model in the company's model register from 2021; approved each retraining release (six between 2022 and 2024) and two changes to the alert threshold.
- Built the telemetry ingestion pipeline that resamples controller data into ten-minute windows and writes the features to the analytics warehouse, with a daily completeness check on each controller's feed.
- Reviewed the flagged alerts each month with two field-service engineers, recording whether the site inspection found bearing wear and adjusting the review list when an alert proved false.
- Took part in a three-month trial that ran a compressed version of the model on two compressor controllers in the company's test hall.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the model-register entry for the bearing-failure model, whose 'Owner' field shows the candidate, with the dated approval history for the six retraining releases and the two threshold changes, plus the alert-review log for March 2024.
